# GTFOBins (fixture)

GTFOBins is a curated list of Unix binaries that can be used to bypass
local security restrictions in misconfigured systems.

This fixture is synthetic: every entry below is invented and points at
`example.test`. It models the collection's index style: binary names,
one link each, no descriptions.

## Binaries

- [awk](https://example.test/gtfobins/awk)
- [bash](https://example.test/gtfobins/bash)
- [find](https://example.test/gtfobins/find)
- [nmap](https://example.test/gtfobins/nmap)
- [sudo](https://example.test/gtfobins/sudo)
- [sudo (git mirror)](https://example.test/gtfobins/sudo.git)
